description:
## [1.31.0](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.31.0) (2026-10-20)

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** fixed downloads saving the update MovieBox trailer instead of the actual video. The previous strict file-size validation was rejecting valid direct file URLs because MovieBox API returns placeholder sizes. Also includes series resolution fix and real file sizes in download list. **Users must re-patch their MovieBox APK** — updating the bundle alone is not enough.
